_readme: Spec 38 §11.2 (D427 amendment) — the CURATED motion-path route presets. ONE file, read by BOTH sides on purpose: includes/fx-path-routes.php reads it for the render-layer expansion (it needs the `d`), and src/blocks/extensions/fx.js imports it for the thumbnail picker (it needs the same `d` to draw each thumbnail, plus the labels). A second copy would be a fifth hand-kept motion list that nothing cross-checks — the exact drift class D427 and Task 3 exist to close. It lives in includes/ rather than src/ because includes/ ships to the server; webpack imports .json natively, so the editor side needs no generator step.
_geometry: Every route is authored in a 0 0 100 100 viewBox and rendered with preserveAspectRatio="none", so the route stretches to fill its box rather than keeping its drawn proportions. The render layer sizes that box to the traveller's nearest positioned ancestor (see includes/fx-path-routes.php + assets/css/fx-motion-path.css), which for an SGS section is the container — so `arc` means "an arc across this section", at whatever width and height that section happens to be. Coordinates are inset from the edges (never 0..100 exactly) so a traveller aligned to the path by its centre is not half-clipped at the start or end.

arc.label: Arc
arc.description: Rises from the lower left, peaks in the middle, settles at the lower right.

s-curve.label: S-curve
s-curve.description: Sweeps right, doubles back left, then right again — a lazy S down the section.

orbit.label: Orbit
orbit.description: A full circle. The traveller ends where it started, so it reads as one continuous loop.

figure-8.label: Figure of eight
figure-8.description: Two linked loops crossing at the centre — the busiest of the four.
